```{r setup}
rm(list=ls())
setwd("/Users/caitlinwaterworth/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-UniversityofBath/YM_combined_analysis/EU_combined_analysis/scripts")
library(tidyverse)

```

```{r load}
## GSE196937 -- Chappleboim et al. 2022 (Nucleic Acids Research)
## 4tU-labelled RNA-seq time course following AID depletion of mRNA processing factors
##
## Strains processed:
##   XRN1-AID  (nf227) -- 5'-3' exonuclease
##   Not1-AID  (aa91)  -- CCR4-NOT scaffold (deadenylation)
##   CCR4-AID  (aa118) -- CCR4-NOT deadenylase subunit
##   Pop2-AID  (aa81, aa82) -- CCR4-NOT deadenylase subunit (two tagged versions, averaged)
##   dcp2-AID  (aa40)  -- decapping enzyme
##
## PAN3-AID excluded: near-zero effect at 60 min, too few sensitive genes
##
## Thresholds at 60 min:
##   Not1-sensitive:  log2FC > 0.75 (n~622, matches paper N=672)
##   Xrn1-sensitive:  log2FC > 1.5  (n~303, natural break in distribution)
##   CCR4-sensitive:  log2FC > 0.5  (n~124, weak effect -- lower threshold needed)
##   Pop2-sensitive:  log2FC > 0.5  (n~123, weak effect -- lower threshold needed)
##   dcp2-sensitive:  log2FC > 0.75 (n~691, strong effect)
##
## CAVEAT: AID depletion in exponentially growing cells, not G1-arrested

samples   <- read_csv("../tables/GSE196937_samples.csv",   show_col_types = FALSE)
genotypes <- read_csv("../tables/GSE196937_genotypes.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
features  <- read_csv("../tables/GSE196937_features.csv",  show_col_types = FALSE)

cat("Samples:",   nrow(samples),   "\n")
cat("Genotypes:", nrow(genotypes), "\n")
cat("Features:",  nrow(features),  "\n")
```

```{r load_tc}
## Load time course data -- filter to relevant strains only
## PAN3-AID excluded (near-zero effect at 60 min)

cat("Loading tc_data -- this may take a moment...\n")

relevant_strains <- c("nf227",  ## XRN1-AID
                      "aa91",   ## Not1-AID
                      "aa118",  ## CCR4-AID
                      "aa81",   ## Pop2-AID (NF066 tag)
                      "aa82",   ## Pop2-AID (NF070 tag)
                      "aa40")   ## dcp2-AID

relevant_samples <- samples %>%
  dplyr::filter(strain %in% relevant_strains, !is.na(iaa_time)) %>%
  dplyr::pull(sample)

cat("Relevant samples:", length(relevant_samples), "\n")

tc_data <- read_csv("../tables/GSE196937_tc_data.csv",
                    show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::filter(sample %in% relevant_samples)

cat("Rows after filtering:", nrow(tc_data), "\n")
```

```{r process}
## Join with sample metadata and filter to verified ORFs
tc_joined <- tc_data %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    samples %>% dplyr::select(sample, strain, iaa_time, rep,
                               control, remove_sample),
    by = "sample") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    genotypes %>% dplyr::select(id, name),
    by = c("strain" = "id")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.na(remove_sample) | !remove_sample) %>%
  dplyr::rename(gene_id = acc) %>%
  dplyr::filter(grepl("^Y", gene_id))

cat("Genes after ORF filter:", length(unique(tc_joined$gene_id)), "\n")
cat("Strains:", paste(unique(tc_joined$name), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

```{r normalise}
## Calculate log2 fold change vs t=0 for each gene in each strain
## Average across replicates at each time point

t0 <- tc_joined %>%
  dplyr::filter(iaa_time == 0) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(name, gene_id) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(reads_t0 = mean(reads, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::filter(reads_t0 > 0)

tc_avg <- tc_joined %>%
  dplyr::group_by(name, gene_id, iaa_time) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(reads_mean = mean(reads, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

tc_fc <- tc_avg %>%
  dplyr::left_join(t0, by = c("name", "gene_id")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(reads_t0), reads_t0 > 0, reads_mean > 0) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(log2FC = log2(reads_mean / reads_t0))

## Average the two Pop2-AID tagged versions (aa81 and aa82)
## Both tag Pop2 with AID, slight difference in tag construct
tc_fc_pop2 <- tc_fc %>%
  dplyr::filter(name == "Pop2-AID") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(gene_id, iaa_time) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(log2FC = mean(log2FC, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(name = "Pop2-AID")

tc_fc_clean <- tc_fc %>%
  dplyr::filter(name != "Pop2-AID") %>%
  bind_rows(tc_fc_pop2)

cat("Genes with FC data:", length(unique(tc_fc_clean$gene_id)), "\n")
cat("Strains after Pop2 averaging:",
    paste(unique(tc_fc_clean$name), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

```{r distributions_60min}
## Extract 60 min fold changes for all strains
tc_60 <- tc_fc_clean %>%
  dplyr::filter(iaa_time == 60) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_id, name, log2FC)

## Summary per strain
tc_60 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(name) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n      = n(),
    median = round(median(log2FC, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    mean   = round(mean(log2FC, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    p75    = round(quantile(log2FC, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    p90    = round(quantile(log2FC, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  print()

## Distribution plots
ggplot(tc_60, aes(x = log2FC)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 100, fill = "#784283", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "black", linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~ name, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x     = "log2 FC at 60 min (depleted vs t=0)",
       y     = "Number of genes",
       title = "mRNA accumulation after AID depletion -- all strains, 60 min") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12)

ggsave("../figures/chappleboim_all_strains_60min_distribution.png",
       width = 14, height = 8, dpi = 150)
cat("Saved chappleboim_all_strains_60min_distribution.png\n")
```

```{r pivot_wide}
## Pivot to wide format -- one column per strain at 60 min
tc_60_wide <- tc_60 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(name = recode(name,
    "XRN1-AID"  = "log2FC_xrn1_60",
    "Not1-AID"  = "log2FC_not1_60",
    "CCR4-AID"  = "log2FC_ccr4_60",
    "Pop2-AID"  = "log2FC_pop2_60",
    "dcp2-degM" = "log2FC_dcp2_chapp_60")) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from  = "name",
              values_from = "log2FC")

cat("Genes in wide table:", nrow(tc_60_wide), "\n")
colnames(tc_60_wide)
```

```{r sensitivity_flags}
## Add sensitivity flags at chosen thresholds
## Not1  > 0.75 -- matches paper N=672
## Xrn1  > 1.5  -- natural break in distribution
## CCR4  > 0.5  -- weak effect, lower threshold needed (n=124)
## Pop2  > 0.5  -- weak effect, lower threshold needed (n=123)
## dcp2  > 0.75 -- strong effect (n=691)

df_chappleboim_gba <- tc_60_wide %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    not1_sensitive = !is.na(log2FC_not1_60)       & log2FC_not1_60       > 0.75,
    xrn1_sensitive = !is.na(log2FC_xrn1_60)       & log2FC_xrn1_60       > 1.5,
    ccr4_sensitive = !is.na(log2FC_ccr4_60)        & log2FC_ccr4_60       > 0.5,
    pop2_sensitive = !is.na(log2FC_pop2_60)        & log2FC_pop2_60       > 0.5,
    dcp2_sensitive = !is.na(log2FC_dcp2_chapp_60)  & log2FC_dcp2_chapp_60 > 0.75)

cat("Not1-sensitive  (>0.75):", sum(df_chappleboim_gba$not1_sensitive, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Xrn1-sensitive  (>1.5): ", sum(df_chappleboim_gba$xrn1_sensitive, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("CCR4-sensitive  (>0.5): ", sum(df_chappleboim_gba$ccr4_sensitive, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Pop2-sensitive  (>0.5): ", sum(df_chappleboim_gba$pop2_sensitive, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("dcp2-sensitive  (>0.75):", sum(df_chappleboim_gba$dcp2_sensitive, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

write_tsv(df_chappleboim_gba, "../tables/df_chappleboim_gba.txt")
cat("Saved df_chappleboim_gba.txt\n")
```

```{r qc_correlations}
## QC -- pairwise correlations between all Chappleboim strains at 60 min
cor_matrix <- df_chappleboim_gba %>%
  dplyr::select(starts_with("log2FC")) %>%
  cor(use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "spearman") %>%
  round(3)

print(cor_matrix)

cat("\nKey pairwise R values:\n")
cat("Not1 vs Xrn1  R:", cor_matrix["log2FC_not1_60",       "log2FC_xrn1_60"],       "\n")
cat("CCR4 vs Not1  R:", cor_matrix["log2FC_ccr4_60",        "log2FC_not1_60"],        "\n")
cat("CCR4 vs Pop2  R:", cor_matrix["log2FC_ccr4_60",        "log2FC_pop2_60"],        "\n")
cat("dcp2 vs Xrn1  R:", cor_matrix["log2FC_dcp2_chapp_60",  "log2FC_xrn1_60"],        "\n")
cat("dcp2 vs Not1  R:", cor_matrix["log2FC_dcp2_chapp_60",  "log2FC_not1_60"],        "\n")

## Heatmap of Chappleboim internal correlations
cor_long <- cor_matrix %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("var1") %>%
  pivot_longer(-var1, names_to = "var2", values_to = "R") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    var1 = recode(var1,
      log2FC_not1_60      = "Not1-AID",
      log2FC_xrn1_60      = "XRN1-AID",
      log2FC_ccr4_60      = "CCR4-AID",
      log2FC_pop2_60      = "Pop2-AID",
      log2FC_dcp2_chapp_60 = "dcp2-AID"),
    var2 = recode(var2,
      log2FC_not1_60      = "Not1-AID",
      log2FC_xrn1_60      = "XRN1-AID",
      log2FC_ccr4_60      = "CCR4-AID",
      log2FC_pop2_60      = "Pop2-AID",
      log2FC_dcp2_chapp_60 = "dcp2-AID"))

p_cor_heatmap <- ggplot(cor_long, aes(x = var1, y = var2, fill = R)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(R, 2)),
            size = 5, colour = "white", fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low      = "#ffa8cb",
                       mid      = "white",
                       high     = "#4575b4",
                       midpoint = 0,
                       limits   = c(-1, 1),
                       name     = "Spearman R") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL,
       title = "Pairwise Spearman R -- Chappleboim strains at 60 min") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1,
                                   size = 12, colour = "black"),
    axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 12, colour = "black"),
    axis.line       = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks      = element_blank(),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA))

p_cor_heatmap
ggsave("../figures/chappleboim_internal_correlation_matrix.png",
       plot   = p_cor_heatmap,
       width  = 8, height = 7, dpi = 150)
cat("Saved chappleboim_internal_correlation_matrix.png\n")
```

```{r qc_scatter}
## QC scatter plots -- how well do related pathways agree?
## CCR4 vs Not1 (both CCR4-NOT complex members)
## Pop2 vs Not1 (both CCR4-NOT complex members)
## dcp2 vs Xrn1 (sequential steps in 5'-3' decay)

p_ccr4_not1 <- scatter_binned_gba(
  df_chappleboim_gba,
  x_col     = "log2FC_not1_60",
  y_col     = "log2FC_ccr4_60",
  x_lab     = "log2 FC after Not1 depletion, 60 min",
  y_lab     = "log2 FC after CCR4 depletion, 60 min",
  point_col = "#784283",
  xlim      = c(-1, 2),
  ylim      = c(-1, 2)) +
  labs(tag = "A") +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.text  = element_text(size = 12))

p_pop2_not1 <- scatter_binned_gba(
  df_chappleboim_gba,
  x_col     = "log2FC_not1_60",
  y_col     = "log2FC_pop2_60",
  x_lab     = "log2 FC after Not1 depletion, 60 min",
  y_lab     = "log2 FC after Pop2 depletion, 60 min",
  point_col = "#ffa8cb",
  xlim      = c(-1, 2),
  ylim      = c(-1, 2)) +
  labs(tag = "B") +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.text  = element_text(size = 12))

p_dcp2_xrn1 <- scatter_binned_gba(
  df_chappleboim_gba,
  x_col     = "log2FC_xrn1_60",
  y_col     = "log2FC_dcp2_chapp_60",
  x_lab     = "log2 FC after XRN1 depletion, 60 min",
  y_lab     = "log2 FC after dcp2 depletion, 60 min",
  point_col = "#e5000c",
  xlim      = c(-1, 3),
  ylim      = c(-1, 3)) +
  labs(tag = "C") +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.text  = element_text(size = 12))

p_qc_scatter <- p_ccr4_not1 | p_pop2_not1 | p_dcp2_xrn1

p_qc_scatter
ggsave("../figures/chappleboim_pathway_qc_scatter.png",
       plot   = p_qc_scatter,
       width  = 18, height = 6, dpi = 150)
cat("Saved chappleboim_pathway_qc_scatter.png\n")
```
